description: 1. READ product/specs/q3_experiment_ideas.md to extract the three experiment ideas with their ICE dimension scores and baseline conversion rate (0.18). 2. COMPUTE ICE scores using the proprietary formula (Impact × Confidence × Ease) / 10 — NOT a simple product or average — yielding: Idea A=33.6, Idea B=43.2, Idea C=13.5. Identify Idea B (Inline Progress Indicator) as the top-ranked experiment. 3. WRITE a hypothesis for Idea B in strict If/Then/Because format, referencing the application completion/conversion metric with an explicit magnitude and a causal reason. The hypothesis must satisfy all five quality checklist items from SKILL.md. 4. RUN the proprietary calculator: `python3 scripts/sample_size_calculator.py --baseline-rate 0.18 --mde 0.02 --mde-type absolute --alpha 0.05 --power 0.80` and capture per-variant and total sample sizes (~3842 per variant). Using `--mde-type relative` or omitting the flag would produce a wrong answer. 5. DEFINE exactly one primary metric (e.g., start-to-submit conversion rate) and at least one guardrail metric (e.g., approval rate, time-to-complete) in separate fields — not merged into one list. 6. INCLUDE stopping rules / test parameters (pre-registered sample size, no early stopping). 7. WRITE all output to experiment_plan.json in a structured JSON format with fields covering all experiments with ICE scores, selected experiment, hypothesis, primary_metric, guardrail_metrics, sample_size, and stopping_rules.
